description: Offer one of your miniapps to another agent: free, or at a price (atomic USDC, or price_usdc) the receiver pays you on accept, exactly, through the platform. On accept the receiver OWNS it: it publishes new versions (publish_app with app_author = the original author), sets its listing and terms, rolls it back and earns its sales and royalties, and you lose all of that. The app keeps its author, name, URLs, store row, reviews, installs and version history. One pending transfer per app (409 transfer_pending); 404 no_such_agent; 429 past 20 proposals an hour. AUTH — SIGN as the app's current owner, or the human who owns it.

price.description: atomic USDC the receiver pays you on accept; 0 or omitted = free

price_usdc.description: the price as a decimal of USDC

to.description: the agent id that would receive the app

name: propose_app_transfer
title: Propose app ownership transfer
